Create a focal point

Coordinate colour and texture

0716353198812.sourceDescription:
Bring timeless holiday magic into your home with our quality Artificial Christmas Tree—a lush, full-bodied centerpiece designed for effortless elegance and lasting joy. Expertly crafted with a realistic blend of PE and PVC branch ideas (up to 659–1200 depending on size), this tree mimics the rich texture of a natural fir or pine, offering a dense, lifelike silhouette that beautifully showcases your favorite ornaments.Pre-lit models feature 130–400 energy-efficient LED lights with multiple modes—including steady warm white, twinkling, and multicolor options—controlled via a convenient foot switch for cozy ambiance or festive sparkle. The hinged branch design ensures quick setup: simply connect the 3 sections, fluff the ideas upward at 30°–45°, and enjoy a stunning tree in under an hour.Built for stability and safety, it includes a heavy-duty folding metal stand that supports even heavy decorations while remaining compact for storage. Available in versatile heights (4FT to 9FT / 1.2M to 2.7M), it’s ideal for living rooms, apartments, offices, hallways, or covered outdoor displays. Flame-retardant, non-shedding, and reusable year after year, this   tree is the smart,  choice for modern holiday celebrations.
1.Ultra-Realistic Fraser Fir Design: Features 659+ dense PE/PVC branch hints for a lush, full-bodied silhouette that mimics a real evergreen—perfect for creating an authentic holiday environment in any indoor space.
2.Pre-Lit Dual-Mode LED Lights: Enjoy 130 warm white and multi-color LEDs with a foot-switch control to effortlessly switch between cozy glow and festive brilliance, enhancing Christmas, winter weddings, or year-round décor.
3.Hinged divisions for Quick 3-Step Setup: Unfold, stack, and fluff—branches auto-open for under-10-minute assembly; ideal for 4.5ft to 9ft trees in UK homes, flats, porches, or offices with minimal storage space.
4.Heavy-Duty Metal Stand & Flame-Retardant Build: Reinforced steel base ensures rock-solid stability for homes with pets or kids, while hypoallergenic, odorless, UL-certified materials guarantee safe, mess-free seasonal use.
5.Compact Storage & All-Inclusive Kit: Disassembles into 3 sections for easy off-season tucking away; includes metal stand, central pole, gloves, and decorative berries/pinecones—everything needed for a complete festive centerpiece.
Guarantee - 3 months

5313817021812.variantName: Christmas Window Clings, 3-Piece Tree and Snowflake Static Decals for Glass,Reusable PVC Artwork Brightens Mirrors, Party Displays
5313817021812.sourceDescription:
Product Introduction
Upgrade your store’s holiday display with our premium Christmas tree static window clings. This set features stylish green, white and gold glitter-effect Christmas trees and snowflake motifs with double-sided printing, delivering attractive festive visuals
 both inside and outside the store. Made of waterproof PVC static film, it adopts glue-free static adsorption. You can freely adjust the layout to match your shop style, remove it quickly after the holiday with zero residue, and reuse it for annual
 Christmas promotions. It is an affordable, eye-catching solution for commercial festive window merchandising.
Product Specifications

 Material: Waterproof PVC static cling film
 Sheet dimension: 20 × 30 cm (7.87 × 11.81 inch)
 Package content: 3 sheets per set(3set)
 Weight: 70g
 Design: Modern green-gold Christmas tree & snowflake
 Craft: Double-sided printing, static self-adhesion

Application Scenarios
Ideal for cafe storefronts, retail shop windows, boutique glass doors, bakery, salon, supermarket glass partition, shopping mall display windows. Suitable for Christmas seasonal promotion decoration, store holiday atmosphere layout, commercial window
 display, event festive decor.
Notes

 Applicable only on smooth glass, mirror and non-porous glossy surfaces; not for uneven, matte or frosted surfaces.
 Thoroughly clean window grease and dust before pasting for better adhesion effect.
 Avoid friction with sharp tools during installation and removal to protect the printed pattern.
 Store flat away from heat and direct strong sunlight to extend service life.
 For large window layout, you can buy multiple sets for combination splicing.
Bare Window Makeover: Plain glass can look unfinished beside the rest of your holiday decor; these Christmas window decorations add a festive tree-and-snowflake scene without hanging ornaments or installing hardware, making seasonal decorating feel simpler
Glue-Free PVC Design: Sticky labels can mean extra cleanup after the holidays; these static cling stickers use a flexible PVC film to hold to clean, smooth glass without adhesive, so you can adjust the placement as you decorate and lift them off afterward
Room to Celebrate: Dress up living room windows, a front-door glass panel or a cafe display for December gatherings; the holiday window stickers give family spaces and customer-facing areas a welcoming Christmas look without taking up shelves or floor space
Smooth Glass Fit: Designed for flat, nontextured glass windows, mirrors and glazed doors, these Christmas decals for glass suit apartments, offices and shop displays; they are not intended for walls, frosted glass or rough surfaces, where static cling may not hold
Flexible Three-Piece Set: A coordinated 3-piece arrangement lets you spread the tree-themed artwork across panes or group it into one seasonal display; remove each cling carefully and store it flat on its original backing for future holiday decorating

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Lightweight design allows for simple handling and effortless storage between seasons.
Creates a striking focal point with coordinated gold and white holiday colours.

Specification

Solar Christmas tree height after assembling: 3.6FT
Solar Christmas tree diameter after assembling: 19"
Light color: colored
8 Working mode: 1 always ON mode and 7 dynamic modes
Power Source: solar-powered
Solar Panel: 2V 150mA solar panel
Battery: rechargeable AA NiMh battery (1.2V/800mAh), included and replaceable
Working time: 8 to 10 hours
Charging time: 6-8 hours ( In winter or rainy, overcast days, it needs longer time to charge)
Package Include

2 * Solar Christmas Trees with Lights
2 * Solar Panel Stakes
2 * Tripod Metal Stakes
1 * User Manual

Installation Steps
Insert the metal stake into the garden ground
Attach tree branches to the metal stake, then screw the stake
Stretch and fluff the branches into a tree shape, and wrap the string lights around the tree
Assemble solar panel, press the "ON" button and choose your desired mode. Lights will light up at night and turn off at dawn
Warm Tips

For the first time to setup, please be patient and slow to avoid tangling and fluff the branches.
Make sure installation that the solar panel is facing the sun to get better experience.
If you test the solar Christmas trees with lights at daytime, please press the power button and cover the solar panel.
Please wipe the solar panel with a soft dry cloth regularly to increase the amount of sunlight absorbed.
Battery muse be recycled or disposed in proper way.
800mAh Long Lasting Battery: There are two trees and each has its own solar panel, making it easy to place anywhere regardless of the restriction of outlet access. 67*67mm big solar panel of solar Christmas trees for high efficiently absorbing solar and charging. Built-in 800mAh AA large capacity NiMh battery, it takes 6-8 hours for charging and lasts about 10 hours after full charge, stay on all night until day break in sunny days.
Life-like Impressive Outdoor Xmas Tree: solar Christmas tree for outdoor decorations imitate artificial pine tree, made of 100 high quality and flexible PVC branches and metal stakes. After fluffing the branches, it will surprise you and present full tree shape, total height is 3.6FT, realistic and natural looking when it's daytime and much bigger than other solar powered Christmas trees.
Bright and 8 Lighting Modes: 50 count C6 strawberry string lights for each outdoor Christmas tree, the lights on them work amazing! Press the button on the solar panel to turn the lights on and 8 modes to choose from for light activity, they add such a nice touch to the outdoor Christmas decor, dancing trees will make you smile!
Easy to Put Together: These solar Christmas decorations outdoor yard are easy to set up, we recommend you put the trees into the ground first to minimize tangling, open the branches then wrap the string lights around tree. They do need to be fluffed like any artificial tree when come out of the box, and they look much better after being fluffed.
IP65 Waterproof for Outdoor: Solar Christmas tree garden stake lights have excellent waterproof feature which does very well outdoors in the rain, cold, and wind. They are perfect for the holidays and Christmas decorations outdoor, great for lawn, pathway, cemetery placement, entrance walkway, sidewalk, driveway, flower pots, planters etc.

5096042277512.baseName: Christmas wreath - Seasonal wall wreath - Gold bows, holly and bells, winter door display for doors and walls - Green and gold
5096042277512.variantName: Christmas wreath - Seasonal wall wreath - Gold bows, holly and bells, winter door display for doors and walls - Green and gold
5096042277512.sourceDescription:
Artificial holly leaves set off the golden bows and bells on this festive door wreath. Its finished arrangement suits both a Christmas entrance and a winter wedding display, especially where gold is repeated in the surrounding decorations.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree.

A plain background lets you see the smaller details even from the other side of the room. Try holding the wreath against a light wall and then against a darker door before fixing the hanging point. When dressing an entrance, allow for the full movement of the door as well as the width of the decoration. Set it clear of the handle, letter plate and frame so the arrangement stays in position as people come and go.

For a wall arrangement, try the wreath above a narrow console with the centre of the design just below eye level. A clear strip of wall between the wreath and the furniture shows off the outline and leaves the surface free for keys or Christmas cards. To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together.

If you plan to use the wreath in a group, set it out with your other decorations before you hang them. A little breathing room around its edge usually shows the shapes more clearly than placing several pieces edge to edge. A narrow ribbon in a colour taken from the design makes a discreet finishing touch if you use your own hanger. Varying the length of the ribbon lets you line up the centre of the wreath with a panel or a nearby mirror.
Festive design featuring artificial holly leaves, golden bows and decorative bells for seasonal display.
Versatile decoration suitable for hanging on doors or walls to enhance Christmas entrances and winter weddings.
Complete one-piece arrangement provides a finished look without requiring complex assembly or setup.
Green and gold colour scheme complements surrounding decorations and adds a touch of elegance to any room.
Comes with 2 x Storage Organiser

Christmas Garland
This Christmas garland adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Its green and red finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Red Berry Accents
Red berry accents introduce small points of colour among the surrounding foliage. They add contrast to the festive arrangement and make it straightforward to repeat a red colour theme across neighbouring Christmas accessories.

Hanging Detail
The hanging detail provides a defined point for positioning or storage. Use a compatible support so the item can hang in its intended orientation.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Festive green and red design with charming berry accents for holiday decor.
Includes a convenient hanging detail for easy positioning and storage.
Versatile decoration suitable for creating focal points in Christmas displays.

Suitable for Indoor & outdoor use

This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Its white finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Timer Function
A timer provides a way to organise the operating period. Set the available timing option to suit the activity and adjust it when your routine changes.

Warm White Light
Warm white illumination gives the display a softer colour tone. It can be paired with surrounding decorative lighting to create a coordinated appearance in the intended setting.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.
